messages:
incident-bot: PAGER | kv-cache OOM surge detected on prod-serving pool (p-serve-prod-03..06). automatic mitigation triggered: mark nodes read-only and notify oncall. alert_id=KV_OOM_SURGE_3327418520 :rotating_light:

maria: I'm on it. seeing repeated cuda OOMs + allocator retries across 03-06. tail latency spikes to 2.3s for chat-gen routes. kv_cache.used_bytes upward trend, fragmentation ratio jumped.

ajay: grabbing logs now. looks like continuous-batching recently rolled a change 22:40 UTC that increased max_batch_tokens from 1024 -> 4096 for low-cost tier; service rate pattern changed and many small greenlet-based coroutines are pinning KV items. lots of small allocations, not getting freed (suspect greenlet localrefs).

maria: can we temp-revert batch config? if we lower max_batch_tokens to 1200 we might stop the growth. however compaction needed for allocator.

lee: I'm spinning a canary with reverted batch config on p-serve-prod-07. patch: 
```bash
# canary rollback
curl -X POST https://config.internal/api/v1/patch 
  -d '{"service":"serve","key":"continuous_batch.max_batch_tokens","value":1200}' 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}"
```
Applying to canary now.

nina: metrics show p95 latency for embeddings route up too. GPU memory fragmentation metric (cuda_arena_frag_ratio) jumps to 0.82. cuda_oom_count=47 in last 5m.

maria: ops-bot run compact on nodes 03-06? we have an in-process compaction tool but it's heavy. prefer rolling restart if compaction fails.

ops-bot: received command: kv-compact --target-nodes p-serve-prod-03,p-serve-prod-04,p-serve-prod-05,p-serve-prod-06 --mode=conservative
ops-bot: starting compaction job (estimated 5-8m per node). will throttle to avoid SLA miss.

ajay: digging into allocator traces. PyTorch/CUDA malloc logs show many sub-64KB allocations which end up fragmenting arenas due to greenlet stacking: 
```
[2026-03-15T22:41:02Z] cudaMalloc(space=0) size=41000 -> arena_slot=8
[2026-03-15T22:41:02Z] cudaMalloc(space=0) size=41000 -> arena_slot=9
[2026-03-15T22:41:03Z] free delayed by greenlet switch -> slot not reclaimed
...
```
Hypothesis: coroutine-local references prevent immediate free; arena bookkeeping grows. compaction reduces free slots but fragmentation remains until restart.

maria: canary rollback looks stable so far (p-serve-prod-07): p95 down to 720ms, no new OOMs. recommend revert cluster-wide.

lee: initiating controlled rollback to services in batches of 4 nodes to avoid thundering. updating runbook: 03-06 will get config applied then monitor 10m between batches.

nina: customer impact: some customers on high-throughput queues saw 502 and reconnects. ops-triage sheet updated: https://rwd/internal/triage/issue/1234. severity: P2 (multiple customers transiently affected).

maria: starting rolling config rollback now on 03-06. monitoring coview. if compaction doesn't bring arena_frag_ratio < 0.6 within 20m we'll restart processes gracefully.

ops-bot: compaction progress: node-03 70% done, 04 35%, 05 queued, 06 queued.

ajay: pushing a hotfix branch to runtime: reduce per-greenlet cache bucket retention and add explicit weakrefs in the allocator path. will open PR but cannot ship during pager.

maria: prioritize revert + compaction + postmortem. Lee, you take night handoff at 3327418600. I'll summarize for handover.

lee: taking handoff. confirmed rollback applied to 03-06. compaction completed on 03 (node-03 frag=0.48), 04 (0.51). node-05 compaction stalled, restarted worker process there. post-restart frag=0.45, no OOMs since restart. global p95 back to 640ms.

maria: handing over: actions done: reverted continuous_batch.max_batch_tokens -> 1200 across affected pool, triggered kv-compact, restarted stalled worker on node-05, created postmortem issue #1234, notified support for customer comms. followups: root-cause (greenlet + large batch tokens -> allocator fragmentation) + runtime hotfix (ajay) + add spectral alarms on arena_frag_ratio > 0.7.

lee: noted. will monitor overnight and coordinate release of ajay's hotfix tomorrow morning. leaving channel open. :thumbsup:

nina: adding timeline to postmortem doc and tagging affected customers for followup.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE | Status: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident channel will remain open until postmortem triage complete.

lee: closing active pager. next update in postmortem.

maria: great job team, thanks for fast rollback.

(END OF THREAD)
